description: Source code for kaiten REST API client, implementing methods to interact with Kaiten project management API, including issue retrieval, creation, comments, and auxiliary functions.

classes.name: kaiten
classes.description: A PHP class providing methods to interact with Kaiten API, including issue management, comments, tags, and user/board retrieval, with internal request handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing kaiten object with context and optional configuration, setting properties, and initializing cURL.

methods.name: initCurl
methods.description: Initializes cURL with specific options, including proxy settings if provided.

methods.name: getIssueURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for a specific issue by ID.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves an issue object from Kaiten by ID.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue with title, description, and optional parameters.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment/note to an existing issue.

methods.name: addExternalLinks
methods.description: Adds external links to a specific card.

methods.name: addTags
methods.description: Adds tags to a specific card.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Retrieves list of users from Kaiten.
